info.name: LLHelper API
info.description:
Коллекция запросов для LLHelper backend

## Timestamp Format

All timestamps in API responses use ISO-8601 format with UTC timezone (Z suffix):
- Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`
- Example: `2024-01-15T07:30:00Z`
- Timezone: Always UTC

**Client Responsibility:**
- Backend returns timestamps in UTC
- Client must convert to user's local timezone for display
- When sending timestamps to backend, use UTC or include timezone offset
